title: [부자재] 관련 문의
content:
안녕하세요 부자재 obj에 관한 clo프로그램 버그가 발생하여 이렇게 QnA를 달게 되었습니다.

CLO CONNCET에서 D-RING 부자재를 다운받은 이후 물체를 CLO프로그램 안에서 사용하던 중 비활성화 및 프리즈 등이 표시되며 클릭되어야 하는 창에서 표시는 되는데 클릭이 되지 않습니다.

아는 지인분께 도움을 요청해 지인분의 컴퓨터에는 표시가 아주 잘 된다고 합니다.

제 컴퓨터의 어떤 이상이 있으면 이런 문제가 발생하게 되나요?

최신 버전의 프로그램과 2024버전 프로그램 또한 같은 상황입니다.

이해를 위해 아래와 같은 사진 첨부하여 글 남깁니다.

가능한 빨리 답장바랍니다.

Comment 1: 안녕하세요🙂 문의주셔서 감사합니다.혹시 시물레이션 모드를 GPU로 사용중이실까요?현재 트림 시물레이션은 GPU 모드에서는 사용이 어려워 CPU 모드로 변경 후 사용해주시면 트림 시물레이션 옵션들이 정상적으로 활성화될 거예요. 관련 메뉴얼 링크 보내드립니다.https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/267abe97c2a64edd91d8e3d413431082안내해 드린 방법으로 시도해보시고, 문제가 해결됐는지 알려주세요.만약 동일한 현상이 계속된다면, 정확한 원인 파악을 위해 관련 파일을 Zendesk를 통해 보내주시면 감사하겠습니다. ^^좋은 하루 보내세요!

title: Meet Dollfication: Community Choice Award Winner of Creator's Contest 2025 Vol. 2 TOKYO CONTINUUM!
content:
## ![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202509/7d219e29b31941549b062b6a6a85949a/images/4830561374eb498eb2c23b250c590c6bjc07.png)_Introducing our interview with_[ _Dollfication_](https://connect.clo-set.com/detail/d6079ef4604240bc85f41958bf578fd3) _, Community Choice Award winner of TOKYO CONTINUUM! ✨_

##  _Discover how she visioned her "Tokyo Continuum" in a doll - an aesthetics blend of anime, sci-fi, and a playful yet confident theme of pink._

![f9fe28a2bf3a44f89a123b3728ca4e33](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202509/7d219e29b31941549b062b6a6a85949a/images/f9fe28a2bf3a44f89a123b3728ca4e33jc07.png)

# **Artist Introduction: please tell us about yourself.  **

Hello! My name is Dollfication, and I’m currently a fashion design student specializing primarily in doll and toy design.

I decided to join this contest because of my deep fascination with Japanese fashion and trends. Japan has such a unique and bold fashion culture that constantly pushes boundaries, and I’m inspired by how it blends art, design, and storytelling. Participating in this contest gives me a chance to immerse myself more in these influences and apply them to my own creative process.

In addition to traditional design, I also work with 3D programs like Marvelous Designer and Blender to create digital models of my designs. These tools allow me to bring my concepts to life in a virtual space, which is an exciting way to explore different garment structures and textures before physically creating them. Perfect for me as a doll/toy designer.

* * *

# **We’d like to hear more about the art direction in your Creator’s contest 2025 Vol.2.**  
**What was the visual style you were aiming for?**

For my submission to the Creator’s Contest 2025 Vol. 2, I drew inspiration from anime aesthetics, sci-fi, and a touch of gyaru fashion, with a focus on a doll-like aesthetic. My main goal was to create a futuristic, metallic look using sharp lines and dynamic silhouettes, while keeping everything centered around one color: pink.

![7d5ba1e2d1034d26a403065a1daa920a](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202509/7d219e29b31941549b062b6a6a85949a/images/7d5ba1e2d1034d26a403065a1daa920ahhh6.png)

Pink was chosen for its versatility—it’s playful yet bold, which worked perfectly with the sci-fi, anime, and doll-like influences. The minimal use of gyaru fashion added an element of confidence and attitude. Overall, I aimed for a striking balance between strength, simplicity, elegance, and fantasy, with pink unifying the design.

* * *

# **Would you be able to give us a quick overview of the different tools you use in your pipeline with a focus on Marvelous Designer?**  
**Have you encountered any challenges and how have you overcome them?**

In my workflow, I primarily used Marvelous Designer to create the outfit for my design. The process was smooth and straightforward, as I had a clear vision from the start. I didn’t encounter any major difficulties, and the program’s intuitive tools allowed me to focus on execution rather than troubleshooting.

![e8a56ef68b4e437f98eac029fccfd075](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202509/7d219e29b31941549b062b6a6a85949a/images/e8a56ef68b4e437f98eac029fccfd075bandicam%202025-08-12%2016-25-43-982.jpg)

The first step was importing the basic measurements for my avatar, which gave me a realistic base for designing the garments. I began by sketching out the patterns for each piece of the outfit in Marvelous Designer, paying close attention to the futuristic, metallic look I wanted to achieve. The program’s pattern drafting tools allowed me to create precise shapes and experiment with different cuts and details, which was crucial for achieving the clean, structured look I had in mind.

![54a7d22f70894b168b51251ea7e55b9b](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202509/7d219e29b31941549b062b6a6a85949a/images/54a7d22f70894b168b51251ea7e55b9bbandicam%202025-08-12%2016-32-03-947.jpg)

Once the basic patterns were laid out, I used the simulation feature to see how the fabrics would move and react in real time. This feature helped me fine-tune the fit and flow of the garments, ensuring that everything appeared natural on the avatar. I also made use of the fabric library to select materials that matched the metallic and holographic look I was aiming for, adjusting the properties such as weight and stiffness to get the right texture. Once the outfit was complete, I adjusted the colors and added subtle finishing touches to match my overall aesthetic.

* * *

# **Are there any tips and tricks with Marvelous Designer that you can share with the community?**

![b665e993e77c42f7ab286e8e91b5198a](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202509/7d219e29b31941549b062b6a6a85949a/images/b665e993e77c42f7ab286e8e91b5198abandicam%202025-08-12%2016-31-37-104.jpg)

One tip I’d share is to use the simulation feature early and often. It helps you see how fabrics behave on the avatar in real-time, which makes it easier to adjust fit and flow without any guesswork. Layering fabrics is another great trick. By combining materials with different properties, you can create depth and texture, especially for metallic or holographic effects. Make use of Avatar Collisions to ensure your garment fits properly, especially in tight or complex designs. It prevents weird bulges or misalignments. Also, if you’re working with multiple pieces, use the "Arrange All" tool to organize your patterns before sewing them together. It saves time and keeps things neat. Lastly, always use the Sewing Simulation to check for any issues with seam placement or overlaps before finalizing the design. These tips can help streamline your process and make the most of Marvelous Designer’s features.
content_description: Explore the creative journey of Dollfication, the Community Choice Award winner of TOKYO CONTINUUM, as she shares her inspiration and design process for blending anime, sci-fi, and playful aesthetics in doll fashion.
